q.en: "I need ___ umbrella — it's raining." Which word fits?
q.bn: "I need ___ umbrella — it's raining." কোন শব্দটা বসবে?

why.en: "Umbrella" starts with a vowel sound, and it's the first time it's mentioned (not specific yet), so it needs "an."
why.bn: "Umbrella" vowel sound দিয়ে শুরু, আর এটা প্রথমবার mention হচ্ছে (specific না), তাই "an" লাগবে।

q.en: "___ Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean in the world."
q.bn: "___ Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean in the world."

why.en: There's only one Pacific Ocean — a specific, unique thing — so it takes "the."
why.bn: Pacific Ocean একটাই আছে — specific, unique জিনিস — তাই "the" বসবে।

q.en: Which is correct: "a university" or "an university"?

why.en: "University" starts with a consonant SOUND ("yoo-"), even though it starts with a vowel letter — so it's "a," not "an."
why.bn: "University"-র শুরুর অক্ষর vowel হলেও এর SOUND হলো consonant ("yoo-") — তাই "a" বসবে, "an" না।

q.en: "Dogs are loyal animals." Why is there no article before "Dogs"?
q.bn: "Dogs are loyal animals." — "Dogs"-এর আগে article নেই কেন?

options.en: It's a mistake — it should say "The dogs"
"Dogs" is plural and this is a general statement about dogs in general
options.bn: "Dogs" plural, আর এটা dog সম্পর্কে general statement
Animal-এর নামে কখনো article লাগে না

why.en: Plural nouns take no article when making a general statement, not about any specific dogs.
why.bn: General statement করার সময় plural noun-এ article লাগে না, যেহেতু এটা কোনো specific dog-এর কথা বলছে না।

q.en: Fix the mistake: "I am going to market."
q.bn: ভুলটা ঠিক করো: "I am going to market."

options.en: I am going to a market.
options.bn: I am going to a market.

options.en: I am going to the market.
options.bn: I am going to the market.

why.en: A specific, known market needs "the" — Bangla speakers often default to omitting the article entirely here.
why.bn: একটা specific, পরিচিত market-এর জন্য "the" লাগবে — বাংলা speaker-রা সাধারণত এখানে article বাদ দিয়ে ফেলে।
